posts.author: nopetter
posts.text: To nye som er sprengt i Hormuzstredet idag,man kan ikke tro annet ratene snur kraftig opp med dette  scenarioet  Around 80 VLCCs remain tied up in Gulf of Oman shuttle operations, with round trips taking 23 days instead of the usual 9–10. That's a massive loss of fleet efficiency, even as Middle East crude exports recover to 80–85% of pre-conflict levels.
